title: Sr. Software Engineer
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $4,000 - $5,000 USD


The Senior Software Engineer plays a critical role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable software solutions that power our partner’s core products and services. This role contributes to technical strategy, mentors junior engineers, and collaborates cross-functionally to deliver high-quality code, drive innovation, and support overall platform growth.


Essential Duties:

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality software applications and systems.
  • Write unit, integration, and other types of automated tests.
  • Participate in architecture discussions and contribute to technical planning and decision-making.
  • Use agentic workflows to write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code adhering to SOLID principles.
  • Conduct code reviews and provide feedback to ensure best practices in coding, testing, and documentation.
  • Collaborate with Product, QA, DevOps, and cross-functional teams to define requirements and deliver features.
  • Identify and troubleshoot issues to ensure system performance, scalability, and reliability.
  • Mentor junior and mid-level engineers to support their growth and development.
  • Continuously explore new technologies and tools to improve engineering processes and outcomes.


Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5–8 years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong proficiency in C# and .NET
  • Strong hands-on experience with advanced SQL, including writing and optimizing complex queries, stored procedures, and database-level business logic in MSSQL or similar relational databases.
  • Proficiency in Angular with Typescript and/or MSSQL
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and deep hands-on experience with relational databases (SQL), including performance tuning and schema design
  • Familiarity with architecture and design patterns such as Hexagonal, Onion, CQRS, Transactional Outbox, and others
  • Familiarity with Azure and/or AWS
  • Proficiency in version control systems (e.g., Git) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.


Bonus / Strong Plus:

  • AI and Agentic Workflows:  Experience applying AI tools to automate or enhance workflows beyond basic tooling (e.g., Copilot), including initiative in learning and integrating AI technologies to improve development processes and operational efficiency.
  • Open to candidates with either a strong backend (C#) background and deep SQL expertise, or database-focused engineers with experience contributing to C#/.NET services


Key Competencies:

  • Full-Stack or Backend Development Expertise
  • Software Architecture & Design Patterns
  • Agile Development & Continuous Integration
  • Code Quality, Testing & Documentation
  • Cross-Team Collaboration
  • Debugging & Performance Optimization
  • Mentorship & Peer Leadership
  • Adaptability & Continuous Learning


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join an innovative hospitality tech company building scalable, high-impact software.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Talent Manager - Independent Contractor
description:
Job description: Talent Manager(Independent Contractor)

**Must send resume in English**

Full-time position.

Pay is $8-$10 per hour paid in USD.


Overview:

The Talent Manager is a critical, detail-driven role responsible for both managing relationships with our independent contractor virtual assistants and ensuring the accurate execution of ongoing administrative and operational tasks that support those relationships. This position plays a key role in Virtual Assistant retention by combining strong interpersonal skills with disciplined documentation, organization, and follow-through. Success in this role requires the ability to build trust, actively listen, and proactively resolve issues—while simultaneously maintaining precise records, managing time tracking, and supporting internal systems and processes that keep the business running smoothly.

Key Responsibilities:


Relationship Management

  • Conduct weekly check-in meetings with each assigned Virtual Assistant while accurately documenting discussions, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Build and maintain professional, trust-based relationships with Virtual Assistants while encouraging open, honest dialogue.
  • Accurately document meeting notes, action items, and follow-ups in real time.
  • Keep Virtual Assistants accountable for meetings, calls, time submission, and other requests or requirements through clear tracking and follow-up.
  • Identify, document, and escalate potential issues or concerns to the leadership team with appropriate context and supporting notes.
  • Create a supportive and open communication environment with VAs, clients, and management.
  • Detect subtle communication cues and potential challenges, log observations, and alert management when appropriate.


Administrative

  • Manage the full onboarding process for new Virtual Assistants, ensuring all documentation, checklists, and meetings are completed accurately and on time.
  • Manage the full onboarding process for new clients, ensuring all documentation, meetings, and follow-ups are completed accurately and on time.
  • Organize, maintain, and manage shared drives and digital files, ensuring proper document categorization, version control, and audit-ready internal documentation.
  • Perform basic website updates such as posting content or minor edits.
  • Reformat documents to ensure clarity, consistency, and professional presentation.
  • Compile reports, summaries, and data tracking related to VA performance, feedback, and engagement.
  • Maintain accurate and organized records of meetings, feedback, action items, and resolutions.
  • Oversee timesheet management, including tracking submissions, following up on missing or incorrect entries, and inputting approved hours into systems for payment processing


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in HR, counseling, or relationship management
  • Proven ability to build quick trust and extract meaningful information
  • Exceptional English verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced typing speed (minimum 70 WPM with high accuracy)
  • Proven ability to multitask (conversing while documenting)


Technical Requirements:

  • Fully remote position
  • High-speed, stable internet connection
  • Professional-grade webcam
  • High-quality speakerphone or headset
  • Modern computer with reliable performance
  • Proficiency with video conferencing tools and spreadsheet software

Personal Attributes:

  • Empathetic and active listener
  • Ability to create a non-threatening, supportive conversation environment
  • Quick thinking and adaptable communication style
  • Patient and persistent in building relationships
  • Skilled at drawing out information from reserved individuals


Note: This is an independent contractor position. Candidates must provide their own equipment and manage their own taxes and benefits.

title: Network Associate (Hunter)
description:
Network Associate (Hunter)


A Trust Insight é uma empresa que atua na economia de insights e de conhecimento especializado, com sede em São Paulo, Brasil. Nossa missão é simples: fornecer os melhores especialistas em determinados temas para ajudar nossos clientes a tomar decisões de investimento mais assertivas. Com nossa ampla base de especialistas de classe mundial, nossos clientes recebem respostas valiosas às suas dúvidas sobre indústria e negócios. Nossos clientes são bancos de investimento e consultorias no Brasil e no exterior. Como parte de nossos esforços de crescimento, estamos em busca de um(a) Network Associate excelente para trabalhar de perto com nosso time atual e manter contato diário com nossos valiosos especialistas.


Como Network Associate, você será responsável por fortalecer, ampliar e ativar nossa rede de especialistas. Você terá um papel fundamental na identificação proativa de especialistas relevantes, antecipando as necessidades dos clientes e garantindo que nossa rede permaneça altamente engajada e atualizada.


Essa função exige forte proatividade, conhecimento de mercado e habilidades de relacionamento, além da capacidade de identificar oportunidades e transformá-las em engajamento qualificado de especialistas.

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

title: Médico Especialista em Demência – Papel Consultivo (Dedicação Parcial)
description:
Sobre a Kuidar+

A Kuidar+ está desenvolvendo um modelo estruturado de coordenação de cuidados em demência , apoiado por tecnologia, para famílias que convivem com Alzheimer e outras demências no Brasil.

Nosso programa atua entre as consultas médicas , oferecendo monitoramento contínuo, suporte ao cuidador, coordenação de telemedicina e navegação estruturada do cuidado. A plataforma combina protocolos clínicos, ferramentas digitais, telemonitoramento e apoio baseado em inteligência artificial para ajudar famílias a lidar com os desafios médicos, comportamentais e práticos da demência.

O modelo é inspirado em iniciativas internacionais de coordenação de cuidado em demência, como o GUIDE Model (EUA) , adaptado ao contexto brasileiro.

Estamos atualmente em fase piloto , construindo o primeiro modelo operacional do programa e formando o primeiro Care Pod da Kuidar+.


Sobre a função

Buscamos um médico(a) com experiência em demência para atuar como Médico Advisor da Kuidar+ em regime de dedicação parcial.

Esta não é uma posição assistencial e não envolve consultas ou atendimento médico direto aos pacientes.


O papel combina dois objetivos principais:


Governança clínica

Apoiar a validação clínica do modelo de cuidado, garantindo que protocolos, critérios de triagem e fluxos de segurança estejam alinhados às melhores práticas no cuidado de pessoas com demência.


Desenvolvimento do modelo de cuidado

Contribuir para o desenho e evolução do modelo de coordenação de cuidados da Kuidar+, incluindo o uso de telemedicina, monitoramento remoto e ferramentas baseadas em inteligência artificial .

O profissional poderá ser apresentado publicamente como Clinical Advisor da Kuidar+ , contribuindo para a construção da arquitetura clínica do programa.

Com a evolução da empresa, poderá também participar de discussões estratégicas relacionadas ao desenvolvimento clínico da plataforma e do modelo de cuidado .


Responsabilidades

  • Revisar e validar protocolos clínicos utilizados no programa
  • Contribuir para a definição de critérios de triagem e escalonamento clínico
  • Oferecer orientação à equipe multidisciplinar em situações clínicas mais complexas
  • Participar de revisões periódicas de casos
  • Contribuir para o desenvolvimento do modelo de cuidado e das estruturas de segurança clínica


Dedicação

Aproximadamente 2–4 horas por semana , com atuação predominantemente remota.

A colaboração poderá iniciar em formato pontual por advisory , com possibilidade de evolução para retainer mensal conforme o programa se desenvolva.


Requisitos

  • Médico(a) com especialização em Geriatria, Neurologia ou área relacionada
  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência clínica
  • Experiência no cuidado de pacientes com demência, Alzheimer ou transtornos cognitivos
  • Capacidade de colaborar em ambiente multidisciplinar
  • Conforto para comunicação em inglês


Por que esta posição é interessante

  • Participar da construção de um novo modelo de cuidado em demência no Brasil
  • Contribuir para protocolos clínicos que apoiam cuidado longitudinal fora do ambiente hospitalar
  • Trabalhar na interseção entre medicina, tecnologia, telemedicina e inteligência artificial
  • Colaborar com um time internacional e multidisciplinar

﻿

Resumo honesto

Estamos no começo.

O modelo ainda está sendo construído.

Esta não é uma posição clínica tradicional em hospital ou consultório. É uma oportunidade de participar da construção de um novo modelo de cuidado em demência , combinando prática clínica, tecnologia e coordenação estruturada do cuidado.

Se você tem experiência concreta na área e interesse em inovação em saúde, gostaríamos de conversar.


Como se candidatar

Candidaturas podem ser enviadas pelo LinkedIn.

title: Director of Marketing | Hotel Technology Experience Required
description:
We are a Silicon Valley based product company building a next-generation, AI-native platform for the hospitality industry. Looking for a Director of Marketing who understands hotels, understands technology, and knows how to turn that knowledge into real growth.


This role is ideal for someone who has marketed to hotel decision-makers before and enjoys building campaigns, writing compelling content, and generating measurable demand.


About the Role

We’re building something special for the hotel industry, and we’re looking for a Director of Marketing who feels at home in the world of hotel technology.


If you’ve spent meaningful time marketing to hoteliers, understand how hotel decision-makers think, and enjoy rolling up your sleeves to create campaigns that drive pipeline, you’ll thrive in this role.


This is a hands-on, full-funnel leadership role responsible for building and scaling our marketing engine. You will oversee demand generation, product marketing, content creation, and go-to-market strategy while working closely with Sales to drive qualified leads and revenue growth.


The hospitality industry values clarity, trust, and solutions that make operations easier. We’re looking for someone who knows how to communicate exactly that.


What You’ll Be Doing

Develop a deep understanding of the hotel ecosystem, including independent hotels, management companies, and brand-affiliated properties.


Stay closely connected to the needs and priorities of hotel decision-makers such as:

  • General Managers
  • Directors of Sales and Marketing
  • Revenue Managers
  • Digital marketing leaders
  • IT leaders


Use these insights to shape messaging, positioning, and campaigns that resonate with hotel operators.


Owning the Marketing Engine

Build and manage the full marketing funnel—from awareness through lead generation, nurturing, and conversion to sales.


Key areas include:

  • Demand generation strategy
  • SEO and digital acquisition
  • Email and lifecycle marketing
  • Webinars and industry events
  • Campaign development and execution


Your goal is to ensure marketing consistently generates qualified pipeline for the sales team.


Leading Blog and Thought Leadership Strategy

Own and grow the company’s blog and thought leadership presence to establish authority in the hospitality technology space and drive inbound demand.


This includes:

  • Writing and overseeing blog content focused on hotel industry trends and insights
  • Creating thought leadership around topics like AI in hospitality, guest engagement, and direct booking strategies
  • Developing SEO-driven blog content that attracts hotel decision-makers researching solutions
  • Implement AI Engine Optimization (AEO) strategies to ensure the company and its content are discoverable through AI agents like Copilot, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and other emerging AI-driven discovery platforms.
  • Repurposing blog content into campaigns, posts, webinars, and sales materials


Creating Content That Speaks the Hotel Industry’s Language

Develop and oversee content that resonates with hospitality leaders, including:

  • Blog articles and thought leadership pieces
  • Industry guides and educational resources
  • Case studies and ROI stories
  • Campaign messaging and landing pages
  • Sales enablement materials


The goal is content that feels authentic, practical, and directly relevant to hotel operators , while positioning the company as a trusted voice in hospitality technology.


Becoming Deeply Fluent in the Product

You will develop strong product knowledge and become fluent in how the platform works.


This includes understanding:

  • How the product integrates into the hotel technology stack
  • The operational problems it solves for hotel teams
  • The value it creates for revenue growth and guest engagement


This fluency will help shape messaging, positioning, and product launches.


Partnering Closely with Sales

Marketing and sales alignment is critical in this role.


You will work closely with the sales team to:

  • Align on pipeline and growth targets
  • Develop campaigns that generate qualified opportunities
  • Support sales with content, messaging, and materials
  • Continuously improve lead quality and funnel performance


Using Data to Drive Decisions

Track performance across the funnel and continuously improve marketing efficiency.


You will analyze:

  • Lead generation performance
  • Campaign ROI
  • Funnel conversion metrics
  • Customer acquisition trends


Marketing should be measurable, predictable, and scalable.


Success in This Role

Success in this role will be measured by the ability to build a scalable marketing engine that consistently generates qualified pipeline.


Key outcomes include:

  • Growth in marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline
  • Consistent generation of qualified leads for the sales team
  • Increased inbound demand through SEO, blog content, and thought leadership
  • Strong campaign performance across webinars, events, and digital channels
  • Clear and compelling positioning that resonates with hotel decision-makers


What We’re Looking For

  • Experience marketing to hotels or within the hospitality technology ecosystem
  • Experience in B2B SaaS marketing and demand generation
  • Proven ability to generate qualified pipeline and measurable revenue impact
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including blogs and thought leadership content
  • Ability to translate complex technology into clear, compelling messaging
  • Comfort operating both strategically and hands-on
  • Experience collaborating closely with sales teams in a pipeline-driven environment
  • Interest in AI-driven platforms, automation, and emerging technology transforming hospitality


Experience at or working with hospitality technology platforms such as hotel CRM, guest engagement, marketing automation, revenue management, or hotel operations platforms is highly valued.


Why You Might Love This Role

You enjoy understanding how an industry works and building marketing that speaks directly to it.


You like owning the entire marketing engine , not just one channel.


You enjoy turning insight, content, and campaigns into measurable growth.


You want to help shape how the hospitality industry adopts the next generation of technology.


Why Join Us

You’ll be joining a modern AI-native product company that is helping reshape how hotels understand their guests, grow direct bookings, and operate more intelligently.


This is a rare opportunity to help introduce AI-powered guest engagement and marketing technology to the hospitality industry while building a marketing engine that drives real growth.


Your work will directly influence:

  • How the industry understands our product
  • How we position ourselves in the market
  • How we generate scalable demand


You won’t just run campaigns—you’ll help define how a new category of hospitality technology is introduced to the market and adopted by hotel leaders around the world.


If you’re energized by hospitality, great products, and building a marketing engine that truly moves the needle, we’d love to meet you.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Pessoa Coordenadora de Marketing
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.



Responsabilidades e atribuições:


  • Coordenação do Departamento de Marketing compreendendo Trade, Comunicação, CRM e Programa de Benefícios;
  • Planejamento do calendário anual de campanhas e eventos e elaboração de plano de marketing com o orçamento de despesas de sua área;
  • Controle financeiro;
  • Negociação com parceiros e patrocínios;
  • Interface com agência de publicidade e promoção: elaboração de briefings de campanhas, plano de mídia, comunicação interna do shopping, campanhas promocionais (mecânica, documentação, premiação, prestação de contas);
  • Responsável pela comunicação do shopping com a assessoria de imprensa: aprovação de releases e sugestão de pautas;
  • Preservar a imagem do empreendimento junto ao público em geral e lojistas;
  • Contribuir com a Gerência de Marketing, participando de reuniões sistemáticas com a equipe para avaliação de metas setoriais, acompanhamento dos indicadores de qualidade, desenvolvimento de planos de melhoria contínua e intercâmbio de informações.


Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Ensino superior completo em Marketing, Comunicação, Publicidade e áreas correlatas;
  • Diferenciais: MBA em administração, comunicação, marketing, produção de eventos.
  • Pacote Office Avançado;


Informações adicionais:


O Que Temos Para Você

description:

Certificada pelo 7° ano consecutivo como Great Place to work aqui na ília acreditamos que pessoas mudam o mundo, e investimos nelas. Nossas awesome deliveries são feitas de pessoas para pessoas, afinal awesome people make awesome deliveries!

  • Participar ativamente em projetos de inovação e melhorias contínuas;

Principais desafios da posição:


• Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Inteligência Artificial, incluindo aplicações de Machine Learning, IA Generativa e automação inteligente.

• Projetar arquiteturas modernas baseadas em cloud-native architecture, microservices e arquiteturas orientadas a eventos.

• Desenvolver soluções que integrem plataformas de dados, modelos de IA, APIs e sistemas corporativos.

• Atuar no desenho de soluções com Large Language Models (LLMs), GenAI, AI Agents e automação baseada em IA.

• Definir padrões de arquitetura para soluções que utilizem plataformas de IA em nuvem.

• Apoiar squads de engenharia no desenvolvimento de soluções com IA, dados e plataformas digitais.

• Garantir que as soluções atendam requisitos de segurança, governança de dados, escalabilidade e observabilidade.

• Avaliar novas tecnologias e frameworks emergentes no ecossistema de AI, Data e Cloud Architecture.


Tecnologias e plataformas com as quais você irá trabalhar:

A arquitetura da companhia envolve um ecossistema moderno de tecnologias, incluindo:

  • Cloud e Plataformas de IA
  • AWS (Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker, Lambda, EKS, Aurora, API Gateway)
  • Microsoft Azure (Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Studio, AKS, Data Factory, Synapse)
  • Google Cloud Platform (Vertex AI, BigQuery, Cloud Run, GKE)

Inteligência Artificial e Machine Learning

  • LLMs e GenAI (OpenAI, Claude, Llama, Gemini)
  • Frameworks de IA (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face)
  • AI Agents e arquiteturas multi-agent
  • RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
  • MLOps e LLMOps

Arquitetura de Software e Integração

  • Microservices e APIs
  • Event-driven architecture
  • Kafka, RabbitMQ e streaming de dados
  • API Management

Engenharia e Plataforma

  • Kubernetes / OpenShift
  • CI/CD e DevOps
  • Observabilidade (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
  • Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Ansible)


Buscamos profissionais com:


• Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

• Experiência comprovada como Arquiteto de Soluções, Arquiteto de Software ou Arquiteto de Plataforma.

• Experiência em arquitetura de soluções baseadas em Cloud Computing (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

• Conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning ou IA Generativa.

• Experiência com arquitetura de dados, APIs e integração de sistemas.

• Experiência com arquiteturas distribuídas e cloud-native.

• Conhecimento em DevOps, CI/CD e observabilidade.

• Inglês intermediário ou avançado.


Diferenciais importantes:


• Experiência com GenAI, AI Agents ou plataformas de IA corporativa.

• Experiência com arquitetura de dados e data platforms (Data Lake, Data Mesh ou Lakehouse).

• Experiência em ambientes regulados como healthcare, financeiro ou telecom.

• Participação em iniciativas de transformação digital baseada em IA.


Nosso jeito de trabalhar, buscamos pessoas que:

• Estimulem a troca de conhecimento e colaboração entre times.

• Invistam continuamente em aprendizado e evolução técnica.

• Conectem tecnologia e negócio para gerar impacto real.

• Busquem inovação contínua e melhoria das soluções.


Informações da vaga:


  • Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)
  • Carga Horária: 220h Mês - 44h Semanais
  • Escala: Segunda á sexta - feira.
  • Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:


• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:


• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:


• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
We’re looking for a hands-on Senior Security Engineer to own and scale security across a fast-growing cloud-native platform. This is a highly autonomous role for someone who combines strong engineering fundamentals with practical, real-world security experience.

You will be responsible for securing infrastructure, applications, CI/CD pipelines, and third-party integrations — while enabling engineering teams to move quickly and safely.


Responsibilities

  • Secure AWS infrastructure including IAM, RDS, networking, secrets management, and Terraform-managed resources
  • Strengthen security across serverless backends, APIs, and cloud services
  • Improve application security across web and mobile applications
  • Embed security into CI/CD pipelines and development workflows
  • Own logging, monitoring, alerting, and incident response processes
  • Conduct third-party vendor security reviews (e.g., payments, identity, infrastructure tools)
  • Support compliance readiness (e.g., SOC 2, GDPR) and assist with customer security reviews
  • Act as the internal security point of contact during growth and audits


Must Have

  • Strong engineering fundamentals (cloud, Linux, networking, APIs)
  • Hands-on AWS security experience
  • Deep understanding of web and API security (authentication, permissions, OWASP Top 10)
  • Experience handling production security incidents
  • Automation mindset (Python, scripting, infrastructure-as-code awareness)
  • Ability to balance risk pragmatically in a fast-moving startup environment
  • Fluent spoken English


Nice to Have

  • Experience securing serverless architectures
  • Exposure to payments, identity verification, or distributed systems
  • Startup or scale-up experience
  • Familiarity with SOC 2 or ISO 27001 frameworks


Role Details

  • Fully remote B2B
  • Contract role (12 months)
  • CET working hours
  • 300 USD per day

title: Coordenador de Order To Cash
description:
Coordenador (a) de Order To Cash | Híbrido - São Paulo


Estamos em busca de um Coordenador de OTC (Order to Cash) . Este profissional será responsável por liderar um time em um momento de transformação, garantindo confiança, autonomia e desenvolvimento da equipe. O papel exige forte capacidade estratégica, mas também disposição para atuar no operacional quando necessário, sendo um verdadeiro backup do time . O desafio principal é gestão de pessoas , com foco em engajamento, crescimento e melhoria contínua dos processos.


Principais Responsabilidades


  • Gestão e desenvolvimento da equipe , promovendo autonomia e direcionamento.
  • Estruturar processos e implementar melhorias, incluindo planos de contingência.
  • Atuar como referência técnica e estratégica, garantindo suporte operacional quando necessário.
  • Importante conhecer todo processo operacional para gerenciar todo o ciclo Order to Cash , incluindo:
  • Cadastro e registro de clientes (novos e recorrentes).
  • Análise de crédito e definição de condições de pagamento.
  • Faturamento e emissão de boletos (PIX, boleto bancário).
  • Configuração de formas de pagamento no SAP.
  • Conciliação bancária, baixa de recebíveis e títulos.
  • Cálculo de PDD e análise da saúde do contas a receber.
  • Apoiar atividades fiscais e contábeis relacionadas ao processo OTC.
  • Propor e acompanhar KPIs e indicadores para gestão da área.
  • Garantir comunicação eficaz com áreas internas (ex.: força de vendas) e clientes.
  • Participar do fechamento contábil mensal.


Requisitos Técnicos


  • Excel avançado (mandatório).
  • Experiência sólida em processos OTC, análise de crédito, cobrança, contas a receber e faturamento.
  • Conhecimento em SAP (configuração e operação).
  • Noções fiscais e contábeis para interação com áreas correlatas.
  • Desejável: Power BI / Power Query (não prioritário).
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Formação superior completa (desejável pós-graduação).


Competências Comportamentais


  • Perfil autônomo , organizado e proativo.
  • Capacidade de liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas.
  • Comunicação clara e interpessoal positivo.
  • Pensamento estratégico aliado à capacidade de execução.
  • Senso de urgência e habilidade para lidar com desafios.


Diferenciais


  • Experiência em ambientes com crescimento acelerado .
  • Histórico de implementação de melhorias e desenvolvimento de equipes.
  • Espanhol (desejável).

title: Especialista em Tracking & Atribuição (Marketing Digital)
description:
Vaga: Especialista em Tracking & Atribuição (Marketing Digital)


Remoto | Empresa baseada em Miami (EUA)



✨ Sobre a vaga


A JZ Smart Media  está buscando um(a) Especialista em Tracking & Atribuição  para construir e estruturar toda a inteligência de dados das nossas operações de marketing. Somos uma equipe jovem e trabalhamos com pessoas do mundo todo.


Hoje, geramos leads através de Google Ads, Yelp Ads, SEO e outras frentes — mas queremos ir além:


Não queremos apenas saber quantos leads vieram

Queremos saber de onde vieram, se são qualificados e quanto faturamento geraram


Essa pessoa será responsável por construir o sistema completo que conecta:


Clique → Lead → CRM → Venda → Receita




O que você vai fazer


Você será responsável por estruturar toda a camada de tracking e atribuição da empresa, incluindo:


  • Configuração e gestão de Google Tag Manager (GTM)
  • Implementação de eventos no Google Analytics 4 (GA4)
  • Setup de conversões no Google Ads
  • Estruturação de UTMs e lógica de atribuição
  • Implementação de captura de dados em campos ocultos (hidden fields)
  • Integração de call tracking (CallRail ou similar)
  • Construção de pipeline de conversões offline (GCLID)
  • Integração entre site, CRM e plataformas de mídia
  • Criação de dashboards no Looker Studio
  • Testes e validação (QA) de todo o tracking
  • Documentação completa dos processos

title: Desenvolvedor Front(Angular/REACT/AWS)
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Precisamos de um profissional auto-didata que conheça front-end esejáveis React/Angular O profissional vai trabalhar em conjunto com o time de IA do Fusion, deve conhecer as IDEs de mercado VS Code e Cursor e como utilizar IA, deve conhecer o uso de Prompts e RAG, e ter noção do que sao agentes de IA. Conhecimentos de banco de dados e cloud sao um diferencial. Fundamental ter conhecimentos de Design System e Figma.



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Back-End Software Engineer Sênior
description:
A GoCache desenvolveu no Brasil uma plataforma de Web Security e CDN, estrategicamente distribuída em todas as regiões do país, que entrega segurança e alta performance para cerca de 300 clientes, incluindo Ultrafarma, Kenlo, Pura Vida, Flamengo, além de instituições do mercado financeiro e do governo.


Diariamente, 20 milhões de brasileiros consomem conteúdo de algum dos 150 mil websites e aplicações que utilizam nossa plataforma, reforçando nosso compromisso em proporcionar uma experiência digital de alta qualidade.

Com foco em garantir que as empresas prosperem no ambiente digital, a GoCache oferece defesa efetiva contra ameaças cibernéticas, assegurando uma experiência online segura e fluida para a audiência de nossos clientes. Nosso compromisso vai além da proteção; buscamos também transmitir uma sensação de segurança e tranquilidade, permitindo que essas empresas se concentrem no crescimento e na inovação de seus negócios.


O desafio:

Na GoCache, você fará parte da criação e evolução de serviços backend de alta performance focados em segurança de APIs, detecção de fraudes e proteção em tempo real. Tudo o que você construir impactará diretamente a confiabilidade e inovação dos produtos que chegam aos nossos clientes.


Somos um time pequeno, colaborativo e pragmático — aqui cada pessoa tem impacto real, autonomia e liberdade para propor ideias, testar, iterar e melhorar continuamente nossos sistemas.


O que esperamos de você

Buscamos alguém desenrolado, com capacidade real de aprender rápido, navegar por contextos complexos e colaborar com outras pessoas do time. Valorizamos quem curte compartilhar conhecimento, tem boa comunicação e sabe tomar decisões técnicas com clareza.

O trabalho é PJ, com flexibilidade de horários. Não esperamos plantões ou esforço fora do horário — mas, se você quiser acompanhar alguma operação ou rotina específica por curiosidade técnica, a porta está aberta.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e evoluir arquiteturas distribuídas escaláveis e resilientes, sempre com foco em performance, segurança e simplicidade.
  • Desenvolver serviços backend (principalmente em Lua e Go) voltados à detecção de ameaças, antifraude e proteção de APIs.
  • Atuar na sustentação de sistemas críticos, investigando gargalos e propondo melhorias duradouras.
  • Elevar continuamente nossos padrões internos: testes, automações, CI/CD, observabilidade e boas práticas.
  • Apoiar e orientar pessoas do time, compartilhando conhecimento de forma clara e colaborativa.
  • Participar da definição técnica de novos produtos desde a concepção até a operação em produção.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • 7 anos de experiência com backend, incluindo atuação em sistemas distribuídos e/ou de alta performance.
  • Proficiência em programação backend (Go, Lua ou C).
  • Sólidos conhecimentos de redes e protocolos: HTTP, TLS, DNS, TCP/IP.
  • Experiência com APIs REST/GraphQL e mensageria (Kafka, Redpanda, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Vivência prática com Git, CI/CD, testes automatizados e observabilidade.


O que valorizamos muito

  • Boa comunicação, autonomia e capacidade de aprender e ensinar.
  • Colaborar e trocar ideias (aqui a gente resolve desafios difíceis juntos).
  • Critério técnico e visão pragmática — evitar complexidade desnecessária é uma habilidade.
  • Interesse genuíno por segurança aplicada ao desenvolvimento.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em ambientes de missão crítica, alta taxa de requisições e baixa latência (CDNs, proxies, firewalls, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de OAuth, JWT, OWASP Top 10 e práticas de segurança Web.
  • Familiaridade com containers, Kubernetes e operações orientadas a performance.
  • Contribuições em projetos open source.
  • Experiência com Prometheus, Grafana, tracing distribuído e logging estruturado.


Por que vale a pena

  • Autonomia real para propor e construir soluções.
  • Flexibilidade total — confia-se no resultado, não no relógio.
  • Zero burocracia corporativa.
  • Desafios técnicos de verdade, impacto direto no produto e espaço para crescimento rápido.


Se você quer trabalhar em um time leve, colaborativo e altamente técnico, construindo soluções que protegem a web brasileira, vamos conversar.

Benefícios

  • Auxílio home-office
  • Plano de Saúde
  • Plano Odontológico
  • Well Hub/ Gympass
  • Auxilio Terapia
  • OnHappy
  • Auxilio Alimentação

title: Arquiteto de soluções
description:

O Desafio

Não buscamos apenas um \"atendente\", mas um vendedor de alto impacto . Você será o responsável por transformar seguidores e interessados em alunos, conduzindo o funil desde o primeiro direct até o fechamento. Se você tem \"sangue nos olhos\", gosta de bater metas e domina a arte da persuasão por mensagem, esta vaga é sua.

Somos referência na preparação de professores para IFs. Temos uma operação validada onde o ganho de R$ 5.000,00+/mês é uma realidade prática do nosso time atual. Oferecemos autonomia, ambiente meritocrático e a chance de crescer em uma empresa com forte presença digital.

Work very closely with Lead Solution Architect – Sales & Operations to meet SAP implementation deliverables.

  • Lead and Support the Product Management Area in the SAP implementation project from solution and architecture perspective and ensure timely completion of related project activities with key focus on quality.
  • Facilitate and support Solution Architects, Workstream managers & leads right from requirement gathering, solution design with focus on Material master data processes and integration of same with sales and Customer Service, finance & Operation workstreams.
  • Responsible for creating/maintaining functional specifications for WRICEF (Workflow, Report, Interface, Conversion, Enhancement, Forms) objects.
  • Analyse, create and document business processes during the project implementation.
  • Support larger project team during configuration, testing, training, migration, cutover, go-live and up-grade phases.
  • Support incidents or change requests for the live Business units.


SELECTION CRITERIA

  • Bachelor / Master's degree in Business, Computer Science, or equivalent discipline is required with minimum 10 years of consulting experience with multiple Industries.
  • Minimum 2 full lifecycle implementations / roll outs & support project experience in the area of material master data, data modelling, data governance in S/4 HANA or SAP ECC Projects with knowledge of integration across financial and logistics processes in SAP as a lead subject matter expert.
  • Hands on experience defining various types of Material master, Variant Configuration, Bill of Materials, Class & Characteristics and Object dependencies.
  • Should have demonstrated hands-on experience in delivery of large, complex, global engagements involving multi-currency, multi-location, multi-organization complexities.
  • Should have solution design capabilities to reengineer business processes, sound knowledge of process modelling, ERP and packaged application fit/gap analysis, addressing critical business challenges typical to the industry or regional process nuances.

title: Immigration Attorney (US-licensed)
description:
About the job

POSITION SPECIFICATION

Position Title: Immigration Attorney (US license is required)

Reporting To: Chief Supervising Attorney

Location: Hybrid (Preferred location: Brazil)

The Company: HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS


ABOUT US

HAYMAN-WOODWARD GMS is a globally recognized immigration and advisory firm. Based in Dubai, UAE, with offices across 9 countries, we specialize in facilitating seamless global transitions for individuals and businesses. Our expertise in U.S. employment-based immigration law positions us uniquely to navigate complex immigration procedures, enabling our clients to flourish in their chosen international markets.

POSITION SUMMARY

As an Immigration Attorney, you will be instrumental in guiding clients through the multifaceted immigration process. Your role demands a comprehensive understanding of immigration law and exceptional client service skills, ensuring successful outcomes in various legal scenarios. Your responsibilities include:

  • Client Consultation and Advocacy : Providing personalized legal consultation, understanding each client’s unique needs, and advising on the most viable legal options. Your role involves zealous representation of clients' interests, maintaining transparent communication, and filing G-28s on their behalf. Representation includes evaluation of complex eligibility and admissibility issues, RFE/NOID prevention strategy, participation in legal strategy meetings.
  • Case Management and Strategy Development: Leading a diverse range of immigration cases from inception to resolution. This includes strategizing tailored solutions, analyzing case specifics, and foreseeing potential challenges to address them proactively.
  • Preparation and Submission of Cases: Crafting compelling petitions for various immigration applications such as work visas, family-based petitions, adjustment of status, and naturalization. Your meticulous attention to detail is crucial in ensuring accuracy and compliance with current immigration laws. This also involves staying abreast of legal developments and preparing detailed legal briefs and reports.
  • Collaboration and Team Leadership: Working in tandem with paralegals, legal assistants, and other attorneys. You will mentor and oversee junior staff to ensure high-quality, timely casework.
  • Response to Legal Queries: Addressing Requests for Additional Evidence (RFEs), Notices of Intent to Deny (NOIDs), and Notices of Intent to Revoke (NOIRs) from government agencies through detailed analysis and preparation of persuasive responses.
  • Appeals and Legal Motions: Managing appeals and motions to reconsider or reopen cases, crafting comprehensive legal arguments to uphold client positions.

EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS AND EDUCATIONAL BACKGROUND

  • J.D. from an ABA-approved law school.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in employment-based immigration law.
  • An active member in good standing with a state Bar, with eligibility to represent clients and sign G-28s.
  • Proficiency in EB1, EB2-NIW, O1, PERM labor certifications, H-1B, L-1, and E visa matters.
  • Fluency in a second language is desirable.
  • Supervisory Responsibility: Yes, including oversight of cases and potential supervision of paralegals and case managers.


KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS

  • Adept at persuasive legal writing and advocacy.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication, customer service, and writing abilities.
  • Ability to work independently or collaboratively within a team.

APPLICATION PROCEDURES

  • Start Date: Immediate.
  • Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, 9:30 AM - 6:30 PM.
  • Location: Remote.
  • Compensation & Benifits:

-Competitive salary

-Home office allowance

-Health insurance (after probation period)

-Dental plan

-CLT employment contract with full statutory benefits

  • Current clients or family members of employees are not eligible.
  • Email your resume and cover letter in PDF format to , referencing \"Immigration Attorney position”.

title: Accounting Manager

Weekly

• Review customer invoicing

• Review vendor bills and submit payments

• Approve and submit payroll

• Perform P&L scrubs

• Review cash flow forecasts

• Resolve collections issues

• Manage weekly recurring accounting processes as directed by the Controller

Monthly

• Ensure accuracy of the balance sheet workbook

• Perform source document filing spot checks

• Calculate monthly sales tax prepayments and submit to Controller for review and

payment

• Review the final P&L scrub and approve journal entries prepared by the Staff

Accountant

• Review and finalize financial notes in financial packages

• Review financial statements and supporting schedules prepared by the Staff

Accountant

graphs, and footnotes

• Provide feedback to Staff Accountants about technical updates to improve their

technical accounting skills

• Review process and procedural documents

Quarterly

Annually

• Review the chart of accounts

• Reclassify contributions and distributions from the balance sheet and income

statement to retained earnings

• Provide recommendations to improve client efficiency

• Prepare and submit client personal property tax filings for Controller review

New Client Implementation

Workbook, and Financial Package

title: Executive Assistant
description:
About Us

We are an industry leader in providing technology solutions in Canada. We are one of the largest technology solutions providers, recognized for our ability to deliver and innovate to meet the changing needs of our clients. Our services include IT consulting, managed services, cloud solutions, infrastructure design and implementation, and software development. We take pride in our ability to provide comprehensive, customized solutions to meet the unique needs of each of our clients.


Position Overview

We currently looking for an Executive Assistant to be a supportive force who empowers our Executive Leadership Team. This role can be operated from fully remote capacity.

This role requires a self-starter with a sense of urgency, exceptional organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure. The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem solver with exceptional communication skills and meticulous attention to details. This person should have experience working in an office environment, performing administrative duties, and providing support to executives. Given the dynamic nature of the executive landscape, we rely on executive assistants to be flexible and consistent while maintaining the confidentiality of high-level systems and our day-to-day operations. You will also assist in coordinating company’s leadership planning cadence, general administrative tasks, office management and support various organizational needs. We are looking for a “trusted partner” who can handle the daily challenges, streamline operations, and ensure the smooth functioning of the business.

The successful candidate will be extremely organized with outstanding attention to detail, time management, and professional communication skills. In addition, they will have solid overall business acumen, approach every task and challenge with energy and tenacity, and handle confidential information appropriately.


Responsibilities:

  • Schedule and manage meetings and other calendar events, including sending and accepting electronic invitations, as well as creating and distributing relevant materials in advance.
  • Plan and orchestrate work to ensure that senior executives’ priorities are met, organizational goals are achieved, and best practices are upheld.
  • Participate in team, management, and executive meetings, take and distribute minutes and action items, and follow up on their completion.
  • Coordinate complex scheduling and calendar management, as well as content and flow of information to senior executives.
  • Being the point of contact for general communications for the Executives they support
  • Assist in drafting and sending communications and correspondence.
  • Create, manage, and file monthly expenses.
  • Assist with travel arrangements and keep track of itineraries.
  • Complete reports and assist with special projects as requested.
  • Manage employee vacation calendars for supported teams.
  • Assist in the preparation of presentations.
  • Participate in event planning.
  • Assist with general office management duties.
  • Provide additional support to executive team members, as directed, to ensure that company goals and objectives are accomplished and that operations run efficiently.
  • Support the coordination of personal calendars and activities as requested
  • Provide general administrative duties as requested


Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Education in business or related field is an asset
  • Minimum 3-4 years' experience in an administrative role reporting directly to upper management is preferred
  • Superb written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional organizational skills
  • Strong time-management skills and the ability to organize and coordinate multiple projects at once
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other office productivity tools, with aptitude to learn new software and systems
  • Flexible team player willing to do what it takes to get the job done; adaptable and enjoys a challenge
  • Event coordination experience is an asset

Additional Requirements

  • Must be able to work remotely in Pacific Time Zone – Vancouver, Canada
  • Comply with background check requirements
  • This position requires reliable internet connection, backup power, and the use of personal equipment such as Desktop/laptop, mouse keyboard, additional monitor screens and a headset

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend Sênior (Databricks)

stamos em busca de um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Frontend com foco em Databricks para atuar em um projeto internacional de alta visibilidade, com foco na construção de aplicações modernas e dashboards de dados.

O(a) profissional será responsável por desenvolver aplicações frontend robustas utilizando Node.js e React , garantindo integração eficiente com a plataforma Databricks Apps e suporte a ambientes orientados a dados.


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações frontend utilizando React e Node.js
  • Construir aplicações como pacotes deployáveis na plataforma Databricks Apps
  • Desenvolver interfaces para visualização de dados e dashboards interativos
  • Integrar aplicações com serviços e autenticação via Databricks OAuth
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de dados e backend para integração de soluções
  • Garantir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, performance e organização de código
  • Participar de discussões técnicas e colaborar em um ambiente ágil e internacional



Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência com React.js e Node.js
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de aplicações frontend integradas a plataformas de dados
  • Conhecimento em Databricks Apps (deploy de aplicações)
  • Conhecimento em OAuth (preferencialmente Databricks OAuth)
  • Experiência com dashboards de dados / data visualization
  • Familiaridade com consumo de APIs e integração frontend-backend
  • Experiência com versionamento de código (Git)



Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com Databricks
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de dados e analytics
  • Experiência com bibliotecas de visualização (ex: Chart.js, D3.js, Recharts )
  • Experiência no mercado de seguros ou resseguros (re/insurance)

  • Modelo: 100% remoto

title: QA Engineer Automation
description:
Estamos buscando um profissional com sólida experiência em automação e qualidade de software. Procuramos alguém tecnicamente forte em Playwright, testes de front-end e API, e familiarizado com práticas modernas de QA, como shift-left testing e Gherkin.

Se você gosta de evoluir frameworks de automação e contribuir para a cultura de qualidade de múltiplas squads, esta vaga é para você.


Junte-se a um time orientado à inovação, focado em excelência de automação e qualidade, sob a liderança de um Coordenador de Engenharia de QA experiente.


Responsabilidades:

  • Executar testes de API e front-end utilizando automação com Playwright.
  • Desenvolver, manter e expandir suítes de testes automatizados dentro dos frameworks existentes.
  • Registrar evidências de testes e garantir a documentação adequada.
  • Colaborar com QEs sêniores/especialistas para apoiar estrategicamente a automação em múltiplas squads.
  • Aplicar práticas de shift-left testing e sintaxe Gherkin para garantir qualidade desde as primeiras etapas do desenvolvimento.
  • Participar de cerimônias ágeis e utilizar ferramentas como Jira, Confluence e X-ray.
  • Habilidades Necessárias (Competências Essenciais)
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento e testes para ambientes web usando React, microsserviços e arquiteturas baseadas em serviços.
  • Forte experiência com JavaScript puro (vanilla).


Conhecimentos obrigatórios:

  • Playwright
  • Git / Git Flow
  • Gherkin
  • JavaScript
  • Postman
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum/Kanban)


Habilidades Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em CI/CD para integrar automação aos pipelines de deploy.
  • Experiência com Docker para conteinerização de aplicações.

title: FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are looking for an experienced FreeBSD Kernel Testing Engineer to join a project focused on expanding and enhancing the Performance Monitoring Counters (PMC) validation test suite for modern platforms.

The goal of the project is to strengthen the reliability and coverage of FreeBSD's performance monitoring frameworks across core, uncore, and IBS PMCs.

You will be responsible for creating new validation tests, improving existing ones, ensuring correct PMC multiplexing behavior, and enabling proper PMC attachment to live processes in FreeBSD environments.


This role involves close work with low-level system internals, performance instrumentation, and automated test development.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and enhance the PMC validation test suite on FreeBSD for modern platforms
  • Validate core, uncore, and IBS performance monitoring counters
  • Validate PMC multiplexing on FreeBSD
  • Validate proper PMC attach functionality to existing processes
  • Design and automate test scenarios across various performance monitoring frameworks
  • Collaborate with kernel engineers to analyze results, identify issues, and propose fixes or improvements
  • Maintain documentation, test plans, and validation reports
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of automation frameworks and test coverage


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 3-5 years of relevant experience
  • Hands-on experience with modern Unix/Linux kernel validation (FreeBSD kernel validation is a strong bonus)
  • Strong understanding of performance management frameworks (e.g., PMCs, perf, hardware performance counters)
  • Solid understanding of x86 architecture, especially performance monitoring hardware
  • Excellent automation and scripting skills (Python, Shell, or similar)
  • Experience designing and implementing automated test cases for performance monitoring frameworks
  • Ability to work with low-level debugging, instrumentation, and system performance tools

  • English: B2 Upper Intermediate

title: Product Specialist
description:
About the Role:

CloudSEK is seeking a motivated and versatile Cybersecurity Operations Analyst to join our expanding global team. This is a multifaceted role that blends Product Support , Cyber Threat Takedown Operations , and Security Event Analysis . You will be the first line of defense in securing our customers and upholding the integrity of their digital presence.

This position is ideal for candidates who are early to mid in their cybersecurity career with 1-2 years of exp and are passionate about threat detection, user support, and protecting brands from malicious online activity.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Technical Product Support (CloudSEK Product) – L1

  • Serve as the first point of contact for customer issues via email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic technical issues using documentation and internal tools.
  • Record and track support issues in our ticketing system with clarity and precision.
  • Collaborate with engineering and security teams to escalate unresolved issues.
  • Contribute to user guides and help documentation for common support queries.
  • Continuously learn and apply knowledge of cybersecurity and threat detection.


2. Brand Protection & Takedown Analyst

  • Monitor, identify, and document phishing websites, fake domains, and impersonation profiles on social media platforms.
  • Initiate and manage takedown requests across hosting providers, registrars, and platforms.
  • Provide timely follow-ups and status updates to internal teams and stakeholders.
  • Assist in building and maintaining playbooks, SOPs, and threat feeds relevant to brand abuse.
  • Work closely with the intelligence team to map phishing campaigns and related threat infrastructure.


3. L1 Security Analyst (SOC/Threat Monitoring)

  • As a member of the comanaged services team, monitor alerts and incidents generated on the CloudSEK portal.
  • Conduct initial triage and classification of potential threats.
  • Document response steps and escalate incidents as per defined protocols.
  • Stay updated with the latest cyber threats, TTPs, and security advisories.
  • Apply AI prompt engineering techniques to improve efficiency in threat detection and knowledge handling.


Desired Qualifications & Skills:

  • Bachelor's degree in Technology, Cybersecurity, or related fields.
  • Prior exposure or a strong interest in cybersecurity, threat intelligence, or SOC operations.
  • Understanding of phishing campaigns, social engineering tactics, and brand impersonation threats.
  • Strong communication skills (written & verbal).
  • Ability to work independently in a rotational shift environment supporting global customers.
  • Experience with support ticketing tools (e.g., Freshdesk, Zendesk, Jira Service Desk).
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity tools and platforms (e.g., VirusTotal, Whois, SIEM, OSINT tools).
  • Basic knowledge of cloud security, APIs, or red teaming (bonus, not required).
  • Proficiency with scripting (Python, Bash) or automation is a plus.
  • Certifications like CEH, Security+, or practical experience in phishing mitigation will be advantageous but not mandatory.
  • Language proficiency: Ability to communicate effectively in English, both orally and in writing along with Portuguese and Spanish


Working Conditions:

  • Location: Brazil
  • Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid (based on location & team structure).
  • Working hours: Rotational shifts to support coverage for US and LATAM customers.(EST and PST).


Why Join Us?

  • Work at the intersection of cybersecurity , AI , and digital risk protection .
  • Exposure to real-world cyber threats, takedown operations, and incident response.
  • Learn from seasoned cybersecurity professionals in a fast-paced startup environment.
  • Opportunity to grow your career in Cyber Security with practical application

Candidate-se agora e seja um #gamechanger!

  • Design creative for product launches, promotions, seasonal campaigns, and evergreen flows

  • Support marketing campaigns across email, social, and digital placements

Optimization & Iteration

  • Iterate quickly on creative based on campaign results
  • Contribute ideas for new creative concepts and campaign approaches


Their Marketing Workflow:

Their lifecycle marketing operates on a structured weekly campaign calendar, with multiple emails and SMS sends each week. You will work inside this framework by:

  • Designing assets aligned to weekly campaign themes
  • Creating creative that supports multiple sends across a campaign window
  • Building creative that can be reused and iterated on across lifecycle flows
  • They move fast and prioritize clear, high-impact creative that performs, not overly complex designs.


Tools & Experience:

Required

  • Figma
  • Email design systems
  • Experience designing marketing emails
  • Strong understanding of mobile-first design


Nice to Have

  • Klaviyo / Attentive experience
  • Experience with lifecycle marketing
  • Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator)
  • Understanding of e-commerce marketing and DTC brands


What They’re Looking For:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Graphic Designer with strong visual design skills, particularly focused on email and marketing content
  • Ability to produce high-quality work quickly
  • Organized and comfortable working inside structured marketing calendars
  • Experience with email marketing and promotional campaigns
  • Understanding of e-commerce and performance marketing


Bonus If You Have:

  • Experience with lifestyle or fashion brands
  • Experience designing for high-volume email marketing programs
  • Motion / light animation for marketing assets


The Type of Designer Who Thrives Here:

Someone who:

  • Moves fast
  • Understands marketing
  • Likes working inside a campaign rhythm
  • Knows that great marketing creative is about clarity and performance, not just aesthetics


Work Schedule: US Pacific Standard Time


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to design high-impact lifecycle marketing campaigns for a fast-paced e-commerce brand.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Senior Credit Risk Analyst – Fintech Consulting Engagement (Remote | Brazil) 300 Software | Full-time Consulting Role
description:
About the Engagement

300 Software is expanding its presence in the US fintech market through a strategic consulting partnership with an online consumer lending company that provides lines of credit of up to $2,000 to everyday Americans for essential needs like medical, home repair, and unexpected expenses. They serve a broad, non-prime consumer segment, making real credit decisions in under 3 seconds in a data-heavy, high-volume environment where credit model performance directly impacts business outcomes.

This engagement is part of 300 Software's growing fintech practice, where we embed analytical and engineering talent within client operations — bringing Brazilian technical expertise to US financial services companies. The relationship has strong potential to evolve beyond analytics into tool development and deeper platform work.


The Role

As a Senior Credit Risk Analyst, you'll work as part of the 300 Software consulting team embedded with the client. This role sits at the intersection of data science, statistical modeling, and credit strategy — with direct visibility to executive leadership and real business impact from day one.

Your core mission is to identify issues inside credit models, analyze loan performance data, and help the team understand whether models are performing in line with expectations — and drive the changes when they're not.


What You'll Do

Monitor and analyze credit model performance, comparing actual loan behavior against model assumptions. Use regression analysis and other statistical and predictive tools to surface insights from performance data. Write complex SQL queries to extract and analyze data from cloud-based data lakes in an AWS environment. Build dashboards and reporting tools to communicate credit risk trends to leadership. Help define which borrower attributes to track and weight in underwriting decisions. Participate in weekly reporting meetings with the US-based team (Central Time Zone, 2 to 3 hour difference from Brazil). Collaborate with engineering and compliance teams to implement credit strategy improvements. Work alongside 300 Software's internal data and infrastructure team, which supports the client's AWS environment and data layer.


What We're Looking For

5 or more years of experience in credit analysis, data analytics, or a related quantitative role. Strong SQL skills including complex queries, data extraction, and reporting. Solid understanding of statistical modeling including regression analysis, predictive modeling, and scorecard development. Experience working with data lakes and cloud environments, with AWS being a plus. Comfort operating independently in a remote setup. Fluent English, as you will be in meetings and communicating directly with the US team. A background in engineering, statistics, or mathematics is a strong plus.


Setup

Remote from Brazil, full-time, 40 hours per week, with hours aligned to US Central Time Monday through Friday. Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience. Contract or PJ arrangements can be discussed.


Why This Role

This is not a typical outsourcing position. You'll be joining a consulting firm that is actively building its fintech practice in the US market, with a client relationship that is expected to grow. Strong performance here opens doors to broader product and tool development work as the engagement evolves.

IHOC - Curitiba

O que oferecemos:

Pesando em seu desenvolvimento, oferecemos o PROGRAMA MAIS SABER – que proporciona descontos, conforme rede conveniada, em instituições de ensino superior e escolas de idiomas


Para contribuir com sua saúde oferecemos o Clude saúde – uma central de saúde que oferece telepsicologia, orientação médica, nutricional, acompanhamento do pré-natal de gestantes e teleatendimento médico.


Somos uma empresa da área de saúde e preocupados em seu bem-estar, oferecemos o PLANO DE SAÚDE e o PLANO ODONTOLÓGICO.

É claro que também temos um SEGURO DE VIDA que cobre as doenças ocupacionais.


Pensando em contribuir com sua refeição na hora do almoço, oferecemos o VALE REFEIÇÃO

Para o seu salário render mais temos a ALLYA – plataforma de descontos.

No mês do seu aniversário a Oncoclinicas&Co te presenteia com o DAY OFF , um dia de folga sem prejuízo na remuneração.


E para finalizar, nada mais justo do que dividir uma porcentagem do lucro com quem trabalhou por cada realização, não é mesmo? Então, se a Oncoclinicas&Co tem lucro você recebe uma grana a mais em nosso PROGRAMA DE LUCROS E RESULTADOS.
